name: ss_ramp
description: Soft-start ramp verification. TESTSS pushes 5µA into C1=10nF; V(SS) ramps linearly at 500 V/s and clamps at 1.2V after 2.4ms. Layer-5c transient_model of kind current_source_with_clamp; the u(time) gate ensures the source is inactive at DC op-point so the cap starts uncharged.

expected.rationale: u(time) gate keeps source inactive at DC op-point; cap uncharged.
Just reaching clamp: V = I·t/C = 5µA·2.4ms/10nF = 1.2V. Source cuts off.
Well into clamp region: cap holds at 1.2V since source is off.
